bar.name: Ash Cloak
bar.text: Shrouded you gain lasts 1 turn longer.

bar.name: Light Step
bar.text: Each attack you dodge restores 2 MP.

bar.name: Killer Instinct
bar.text: Your skills +4% critical chance against targets below 50% HP.

bar.name: Trophy
bar.text: Each kill this battle adds +3% to your critical damage.

bar.name: Reaper's Due
bar.text: Your first kill each battle resets the cooldowns of your other skills.

0.f1.name: Cold Read
0.f1.text: Opportunist bonus +3% per rank against targets below 50% HP.

0.f2.name: Vein Finder
0.f2.text: Your hits on Opportunist targets +2% critical chance per rank.

0.f3.name: Feinting Step
0.f3.text: Each attack you dodge adds +2% per rank Opportunist bonus to your next hit.

0.n0.name: Smell of Blood
0.n0.text: Opportunist also counts any enemy below 40% HP, status or not.

0.r.name: Missed Chance
0.r.text: Opportunist bonus +4% per rank against an enemy that missed you since your last turn.

0.ea.name: Killer's Eye
0.ea.text: Your critical hits on Opportunist targets deal +20% damage.

0.eb.name: Counter Cut
0.eb.text: When a melee enemy misses you, cut it back for 40% DEX; Opportunist applies.

0.ma.name: Bloodletter
0.ma.text: Your critical hits Wound for 2 turns, so every crit opens an Opportunist target.

0.fa.name: Glass Knife
0.fa.text: Your critical hits on Opportunist targets deal +40%, but non-critical hits on them deal 15% less.

0.fb.name: Reckless Grace
0.fb.text: Counter cuts deal double damage, but each counter ends your Shrouded.

0.mb.name: Turned Blade
0.mb.text: Your counter cuts crit against Blinded attackers and Blind them again for 1 turn.

0.v.name: Assassin's Instinct
0.v.text: Opportunist also grows with missing HP: +1% per 2% HP the target is missing, used when higher than its normal bonus.

1.f1.name: Balanced Blade
1.f1.text: Venom Edge +3% power per rank against Wounded targets.

1.f2.name: Seeking Tip
1.f2.text: Venom Edge +2% critical chance per rank.

1.f3.name: Twist the Knife
1.f3.text: Venom Edge's critical hits deal +5% damage per rank.

1.n0.name: Coup de Grace
1.n0.text: Venom Edge always crits against targets below 30% HP.

1.r.name: Honed Point
1.r.text: Venom Edge +3% power per rank against targets below 50% HP.

1.ea.name: Finishing Cut
1.ea.text: Venom Edge +30% damage against targets below 30% HP.

1.eb.name: Backhand Cut
1.eb.text: Venom Edge's backswing also cuts one enemy beside the target for 50% and Wounds it.

1.ma.name: Clean Kill
1.ma.text: If Venom Edge kills, you regain 6 MP and Backstab's cooldown drops by 1.

1.fa.name: Butcher's Haste
1.fa.text: Venom Edge +25% against targets below 50% HP, but -25% against targets above it.

1.fb.name: Thirsty Edge
1.fb.text: Venom Edge heals you for 25% of its damage on a kill, but no longer Wounds.

1.mb.name: Carving Arc
1.mb.text: Venom Edge's backswing keeps going to each new enemy beside the last one, up to 3 cuts.

1.v.name: Red Smile
1.v.text: Venom Edge becomes a throat cut: below 50% HP it deals double and always crits; above 50% it Wounds for 3 turns.

2.f1.name: Crossed Crit
2.f1.text: Saltire Cut +3% critical chance per rank on its center target.

2.f2.name: Scissor Bite
2.f2.text: Saltire Cut's second center hit +5% power per rank.

2.f3.name: Keen Pair
2.f3.text: Saltire Cut +4% power per rank against targets below 50% HP.

2.n0.name: Finishing Cross
2.n0.text: If Saltire Cut kills any enemy, its cooldown resets.

2.r.name: Bloody Saltire
2.r.text: Saltire Cut has a 10% chance per rank to Wound each enemy it crits.

2.ea.name: Double Lunge
2.ea.text: Saltire Cut's center hits +25% power against targets below 50% HP.

2.eb.name: Extra Knife
2.eb.text: Saltire Cut hits its center a third time.

2.ma.name: X Marks the Throat
2.ma.text: If both center hits crit, the center target takes a third hit that ignores Armor.

2.fa.name: Heavy Cross
2.fa.text: Saltire Cut's center hits +40%, but its diagonal hits deal 50% less.

2.fb.name: Spent Belt
2.fb.text: Saltire Cut hits its center 4 times, but costs 14 MP.

2.mb.name: Endless Knives
2.mb.text: Each Saltire Cut hit that crits throws one more knife at the same target, up to 2 extra.

2.v.name: Butcher's Cross
2.v.text: Saltire Cut hits every enemy in the X twice, not just the center; power 0.45 to 0.35.

3.f1.name: Far Toss
3.f1.text: Smoke Bomb's Blinded has a 15% chance per rank to last 1 turn longer on back-row enemies.

3.f2.name: Lungful of Ash
3.f2.text: Smoke Bomb's Blinded lowers accuracy by a further 2% per rank.

3.f3.name: Gritty Ash
3.f3.text: Smoke Bomb's Blinded also lowers critical chance by 2% per rank.

3.n0.name: Choking Cloud
3.n0.text: Smoke Bomb on enemies also Silences them for 1 turn.

3.r.name: Coughing Fit
3.r.text: Smoke Bomb has a 6% chance per rank to Slow each enemy in it for 1 turn.

3.eb.name: Exposed in Smoke
3.eb.text: Smoke Bomb leaves the lowest-HP enemy in it Overextended: +25% damage taken until its next turn.

3.ma.name: Lost in Smoke
3.ma.text: A Blinded enemy that misses an attack is Staggered and loses its next action.

3.fa.name: Sulfur Overload
3.fa.text: Smoke Bomb's Blinded is -45% accuracy, but it can no longer Shroud allies.

3.fb.name: Hard Clay
3.fb.text: Smoke Bomb Stuns one random enemy in it for 1 turn, but no longer Blinds anyone.

3.mb.name: Shrapnel Shell
3.mb.text: Smoke Bomb bursts into clay shards: 35% DEX damage to every enemy in it, all Wounded for 2 turns.

3.v.name: Brimstone Jar
3.v.text: Smoke Bomb becomes a brimstone jar: enemies in it are Blinded and Silenced for 2 turns and Slowed for 1.

4.u1.name: Into the Smoke
4.u1.text: After Backstab, you gain Shrouded for 2 turns.

4.u2.name: Smoke Trail
4.u2.text: After Backstab, its target is Blinded for 2 turns.

4.u3.name: Shadow Return
4.u3.text: After Backstab, you and every ally beside you are Shrouded for 2 turns and gain Fleet.

4.r2.name: First Blood
4.r2.text: Backstab +25% power against targets at full HP.

4.r3.name: Opening Act
4.r3.text: Your first Backstab each battle triggers no cooldown.

4.d3.name: Spine Splitter
4.d3.text: Backstab ignores all Armor against targets below 50% HP.

4.l1.name: Thrown Stiletto
4.l1.text: Backstab can hit a target with no open cell behind it; such hits deal 30% less.

4.l2.name: Weighted Stiletto
4.l2.text: A thrown Backstab also Wounds for 3 turns.

4.l3.name: Death From Afar
4.l3.text: Backstab no longer needs an open cell behind its target and always deals full damage.
